title: Erine Gray (16-year founder) — Incorruptible 'can be timeless' alongside Good to Great and How to Win Friends and Influence People
summary: Erine Gray — 16-year builder — publishes a personal thank-you note on X: Incorruptible is 'fundamentally sound and written with the same seriousness of Jim Collins' Good to Great, and Dale Carnegie's How to Win Friends and Influence People. It can be timeless.' Cites the last chapter's call to resist the urge to be tired and stick with idealism as the framing that reached him.
blockquote: But this book, Incorruptible, is fundamentally sound and written with the same seriousness of Jim Collins' Good to Great, and Dale Carnegie's How to Win Friends and Influence People. It can be timeless.
